title: Data removal — Niko
heading.body: Request deletion of account data or a server's data. Every request is reviewed and ownership is verified first. Safety and moderation records are protected on purpose — so this process can never be used to erase a ban, warning, or investigation.
form.title: Start a deletion request
signin.title: Sign in to verify ownership
signin.body: Deletion requests are tied to the Discord account that owns the data or server. Signing in is how that ownership is confirmed.
server.label: Server
server.present: Niko is in this server · you are the owner
server.removed: Niko was removed · owner at removal recorded
server.empty: No owner-verified servers were found. Only the member who owns the server, or owned it when Niko was removed, can request its deletion.
server.emptyLegacy: If you removed Niko before this ownership record existed, contact the bot owner through the support server with proof that you owned the server.
reason.label: Why are you requesting this?
reason.placeholder: Required. A short, honest explanation helps the review go quickly.
confirm.labelServer: Type the server name to confirm
understood: I understand that moderation and safety records are preserved, that this does not lift any restriction, and that deletion cannot be undone.
fineprint: Submitting does not delete anything immediately. A pending request can be withdrawn.
history.title: Your requests

error.auth: Sign-in status could not be checked. Refresh the page to try again.
error.submit: The request could not be submitted.
error.withdraw: The request could not be withdrawn.

policy.title: What this process can and cannot delete
policy.account.title: Account data
policy.account.body: Deletes the personal data attached to your Discord account: economy balances, leveling XP, birthdays, reminders, AFK state, music library, giveaway entries, poll votes, roleplay preferences, AI conversation memory, staff application submissions, and any public staff profile (bio, banner, and links). Your name is also removed from suggestions and giveaway hosts where it was attached to server content.
policy.server.title: Server data
policy.server.body: Deletes a server's Niko configuration and content: AutoMod and logging settings, AI settings and conversation memory, leveling data, tickets configuration, giveaways, polls, starboard entries, social notifier follows, voicemaster settings, profiles, and related settings. The server's deletion stays available after Niko is removed, as long as you were the owner when it left.
policy.instances.title: Which instances this covers
policy.instances.bodyBefore: This form covers the official public Niko instances only, where all user data is stored in a private MongoDB database that the Niko team controls. Private, beta, and self-hosted instances are run by other people and are outside our control: they may use the deprecated SQLite storage or another database, and we cannot access, correct, or delete their data. We cannot handle data-removal, access, or support requests about those instances — send them to the operator of that instance. The
policy.instances.bodyAfter: also publishes the full retention schedule.
policy.preserved.title: What is always preserved
policy.preserved.bodyAfter: deleted by an account or server request. This includes bot-level blacklists, warnings, mutes, moderation cases, logs and ticket transcripts, giveaway bans, abuse strikes, and scam-image reports. Deleting everything else does not lift a restriction, restore access, or remove evidence of abuse.
policy.legal.title: Legal or court-ordered deletion
policy.legal.bodyBefore: If a law requires deletion of a preserved moderation or safety record, do not use this form. Send a formal legal request directly to the bot owner by email at
policy.legal.bodyAfter: It must include a court record or a signed legal document and the contact details of an official legal representative so authenticity can be verified. These requests are handled personally and confidentially. Ordinary requests never receive special treatment, and the strict review protects the community from people trying to erase the consequences of abuse.
policy.review.title: How review works
policy.review.account: Requests are accepted only from the signed-in Discord account they belong to.
policy.review.owner: A server request must match the recorded owner, or the current owner if Niko is still in the server.
policy.review.limit: One open request is allowed per account or server, with a small daily limit.
policy.review.ownerReview: The bot owner reviews every request. Withdraw a pending request at any time.
policy.review.irreversible: Deletion is irreversible. Financial records required for accounting, fraud prevention, and refunds are retained.
policy.contact.before: Questions about a request? Open a private ticket in the
policy.contact.after: and quote your request ID. Do not post identity documents in a public channel.
